verdict.rationale: The only story-specific evidence is a community comment saying there is no Linear integration in the free version, which implies a paid-tier Linear integration exists. Superset's documented 'tasks' (SDK, CLI, MCP) are its own task system, not connections to external trackers, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: first-party documentation of any issue-tracker integration, Jira/ClickUp/Monday.com support, evidence that agents can read or update tickets directly, and hands-on corroboration of the Linear integration's depth.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: No linear integration in free version and taxing it 20$/m is a bit steep.
